title: 5-Year Breakeven Inflation Rate (percent, daily, not seasonally adjusted)
source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED; calculated from U.S. Treasury yields (DGS5 minus DFII5). U.S. government-derived data.
retrieved_via: in-page fetch in the browser on the user's computer (sandbox cannot reach FRED); SHA-256 computed in the browser before transfer
window_filter: observations 2011-12-01..2026-09-30 with a non-missing value, written as YYYYMMDD,value and split into four parts joined by \n (no trailing newline)
cross_check: The four parts joined by \n equal ALFRED's latest-vintage table for the same window (SHA-256 above); see alfred_vintage_evidence_v1.json
